patterns.note: Full-width sections with content constrained to a central maximum width, creating a strong, structured presentation.
Prominent, oversized, bold, and uppercase sans-serif typography is used for all major headings, establishing a powerful brand voice.
High-contrast color blocking is used for brand showcases, featuring vibrant, full-bleed background colors with white text.

A large mammoth silhouette graphic in the hero section acts as a background element that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax effect and maintaining a visual brand anchor throughout the initial scroll.
Sections are clearly delineated by alternating dark background colors (black and dark grey), providing visual separation and rhythm.

technique_notes: Implement a large background image in the hero section that is fixed or has a slow parallax scroll speed, allowing the main content to scroll over it and gradually reveal more of the background image as the user scrolls down the page.
Utilize a grid layout for showcasing brands and team members, where each item occupies a distinct, often colorful, block.
Employ a distinct, heavy, all-caps sans-serif for prominent titles and a more neutral, legible sans-serif for body copy to establish a clear typographic hierarchy.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, and wide uppercase display headings (~4-5x body text) with a clear hierarchy down to smaller, readable sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in the hero section, transitioning to a balanced density for content sections with generous vertical padding between blocks.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the persistent, large, graphic header element (the mammoth silhouette) that acts as a fixed or very slow parallax background, creating a strong, ever-present brand anchor. The use of bold, full-bleed color blocks for each brand also provides a memorable visual impact.
